title: Wrap the innermost complex objects first
description: billing.contact must already be an array by the time billing itself is wrapped, or wrapping billing clones contact away in its pre-wrap shape — see docs/ai-ref/commands/SetProperties.md.

title: Wrap what's left under customer
description: address and the now fully-wrapped billing both become one-element arrays; customerNumber and name are primitives and stay untouched.
